resources.string: Tap Talk and say something in English.
Take turns: speak, listen, then tap Talk again.
Sati needs microphone access to hear your English. You can choose Not now.
Microphone access is needed to hear you. Tap Try again when you’re ready.
Microphone access is off. Ask a grown-up to enable it in app settings.
Speech recognition is unavailable. Ask a grown-up to check this device’s speech services, then try again.
I didn’t catch that. Tap Try again and say something in English.
There was a connection problem. Check your connection and try again.
I couldn’t hear you this time. Let’s try again.
Sati’s voice isn’t ready. Ask a grown-up to check text-to-speech settings, then try again.
An English voice is missing. Ask a grown-up to install one in text-to-speech settings, then try again.
I couldn’t play my reply. Tap Try again for another turn.
